notes.title: Neckbreak available on Geforce Now + 65% Sale
notes.content: [h3][b]About time![/b] [/h3][p][/p][p]Neckbreak [b]is finally officially available on Geforce Now[/b] via the new [b]install to play[/b] function. I'm especially happy because I've been a big fan of the service ever since it was in Beta. Was lucky enough to test it back then, including Neckreak when it was in Alpha/pre-release, when all Steam library games were available in the service. So it's great news that Nvidia finally added and made games which applied for the service playable. Currently the [b]install to play[/b] function is only limited to premium subscriptions, but hopefully they will expand this in time.[/p][p][/p][p][b]So to mark the occasion there will be a 65% discount till the end of the month.[/b]  And if you enjoyed your trip through Crimson Tide, the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49986/Door_Breakers/"]Doorbreakers[/url] bundle might be worth a gander, especially with Unbroken: the Awakenings major update just round the corner.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34126215/82dd3d736121a17889c60b9daa6c4e51aba37b08.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Personally I'm really enjoying Geforce Now on the Quest 3. Playing Neckbreak with its trippy arcade style on a personal IMAX like screen is pretty sweet! Running it couldn't be easier. If you own the game, simply open up geforce now on your browser, log in and link up your steam account, install and play.[/p][p][/p][p]In other news, recommend marking 23rd September on your calendars. Boomstock is just around the corner and with it, some juicy stuff coming to Neckbreaks Victorian-Gothic spiritual spinoff "Unbroken: the Awakening".[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34126215/443140debd8b0f3b95fdc0d0abcae8fdbc0508e7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As for Neckbreaks direct continuation "Codename TCT", I will be aiming to get a demo out by the end of the year.[/p][p][/p][p]So that's it for this one. Thanks for tuning in![/p][p][/p][p]The Neckbreak team,[/p][p][/p][p]Mike & Dawid[/p]

notes.title: Neckbreak
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Everyone,[/h3]

First off, we are very sorry for the whole mess and confusion over the last few days. The game was supposed to be relisted under the new name on July 5th, 10AM PDT. I already reached out to Steam support multiple times over the last days in the matter so hopefully the game will be back up soon.

We really worked hard to keep that date and had everything synched and set up (or so it seemed) and it breaks our heart with how it turned out. But it is what it is. We promise we are doing our best to get the game live.

As for the title change and cosmetic changes to the game: sadly I am not at liberty to go into details.

I can share we had to make some cosmetic changes and the core of the game and gameplay remains unchanged. It is the same game, which I hope you will enjoy just as much as before.

[b]EDIT (15-Jul-24): [/b]Update. Looks like there was a bug with Steam. Just got confirmation from support that the game should be live now. 

Thanks for sticking by,

Mike & Dawid
